description: Native lane: true 32-bucket Bullet Enyo scratch smoke rejected by checkpoint gates.

metadata.hypothesis: Previous native Bullet runs exported legacy 16-bucket nets. A short 32-bucket scratch curve should verify whether the current runtime layout learns at least as well before any larger native run.
metadata.result: training completed and exported full-size 32-bucket checkpoints, but 512 and 1024 failed the 300k-node search gate catastrophically
metadata.decision: reject; no SPRT and no continuation of same-architecture 32-bucket scratch without a larger data-scale plan or different objective
